stem:
Nupur orders the stages of a frog after a pond visit and notes how the body changes.

Which statements are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The sequence is eggs → tadpole → froglet → adult frog.
As a froglet becomes an adult, its tail shortens.
The sequence is eggs → froglet → tadpole → adult frog.
Adult frogs begin life already with four legs and no tadpole stage.

teacher.key_rationale: Frog order is eggs, tadpole, froglet, then adult; the tail shortens as the froglet becomes an adult. Swapping tadpole and froglet reverses the sequence. Adults do not skip the tadpole stage.
